statements.query:
WITH open_orders AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT customer_id, amount FROM orders WHERE status = $1)
UPDATE customer_stats cs SET open_amount = s.total FROM (SELECT customer_id, sum(amount) total FROM open_orders GROUP BY 1) s WHERE cs.customer_id = s.customer_id
SELECT segment, count(*) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY segment
